Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone symbol for PROWL scientific software documentation.
Primary request: A minimal angular owl-head emblem cut from a single bold charcoal silhouette, two pointed upper corners and a tapered lower edge. No feathers, no body, no cartoon.
Context: PROWL projects VASP wavefunctions onto local atomic orbitals to analyze chemical bonding; intended for scientists.
Style: premium minimalist flat vector-like logo exploration, precise edges, strong memorable silhouette, balanced negative space; must be feasible to redraw as an SVG later.
Palette: muted deep teal #167D8D and charcoal #24323D only. No gradients, shadows, textures, glow, 3D, mockups, embellishments or watermark.
Composition: one centered symbol on a pure white square canvas, generous whitespace, symbol occupies about half the canvas width. No framing box.
Text: absolutely no text, no words, no numerals; for the P monogram only, the P IS the symbol.
Produce exactly one logo.
